svg.aria-label: Breeze: a free, open-source Mac cleaner for developers. Clears node_modules, Xcode DerivedData and developer caches, uninstalls apps with their leftovers, and deletes nothing until you review it. 382.25 GB freed on my own Mac.

g.text: NOW SHIPPING · v1.4 · FREE & OPEN SOURCE
The Mac cleaner I wanted as a developer.
Clears node_modules, DerivedData and dev caches
Uninstalls apps along with their leftovers
Deletes nothing until you have reviewed it
freed on my own Mac so far
